annotations.title: Read one issuer-filed document as passages

description: Return one issuer-filed document (from call_materials or issuer_releases) as ordered passages: section (prepared_remarks, qa, safe_harbor...), speaker, role, whether the speaker is company or analyst, topic tags and character offsets into the filed text. Filter with topic "guidance" for passages about outlook, "kpi" for operating metrics, or by section or speaker. Topic tags are keyword rules that say where to read, not extracted figures; quote the passage and cite its ref and source_url. Text is null when the filed document carries another party's copyright notice: follow source_url instead. Use it to read what management said in a filed document, passage by passage.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (data.next_cursor).

id.description: Document id, for example doc_123 (from call_materials or issuer_releases).

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 40, at most 500).

speaker.description: Only passages whose speaker name contains this text.

topic.description: Only passages tagged with this topic (guidance, results, kpi, capital_return...).

name: call_material

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { document: { id, kind, title, fiscal_period, accession, has_qa, text_served, third_party_notice, source_url, retrieved_at }, sections: [{ section, passages, speakers }], passages: [{ seq, section, speaker, speaker_role, speaker_kind, topics, char_start, char_end, text, ref }], next_cursor, related, note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Read one issuer-filed document as passages
